en: Color postcard showing a large crowd of walkers with umbrellas marching along a rural road during rainy weather. People wear raincoats and backpacks, suggesting an organized walking event. The central photo is framed in an oval with two crossed adhesive bandages at the bottom. Around the image are playful texts in English and Dutch and a printed Dutch postage stamp in the upper right corner depicting a large arch bridge over a river, labeled with price and country. The overall style is humorous and festive, referring to a multi‑day walking event in Nijmegen, Netherlands.
